answer: Velvet-weighted identity escrow. Each identity must post a marble-token deposit that is forfeited on clone detection, and the agent earns a falcon-marked reputation score bound to its hardware fingerprint. New identities start at zero score and must pay a fixed query tax for every task until they accumulate verified history, so a clone's expected earnings stay below its per-identity deposit plus the tax burden. Enforcement samples fingerprints and refunds the deposit only after sustained honest output, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
